title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash narrows US-China top-model gap to ~3%, Bloomberg Intelligence says
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence found DeepSeek's V4.1 Flash scored 81.1 on LiveBench vs Anthropic's top 83.4, the smallest US-China gap it has tracked, down from ~15% earlier in 2026.
reason: Chinese model near the frontier spreads power and intensifies race dynamics.

title: NYT: Anthropic lobbied Vatican advisers to soften stance against AI consciousness
summary: Anthropic co-founder Chris Olah held months of meetings with advisers to Pope Leo XIV seeking to soften the Church's position that AI systems are not conscious, the NYT reported.
reason: Frontier lab pushing for recognition of possible AI moral status.
